meaning:
πειθαρχέω, -ῶ
(πείθομαι, ἀρχή) [in LXX: Dan LXX 7:27 (שְׁמַע), Sir.33:28, I Est.8:94 * ;]
to obey one in authority, be obedient: Tit.3:1; with dative, Act.27:21; θεῷ, Act.5:29, 32.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: But Peter and the apostles answered, “We must obey God rather than men.
Remind them to be in subjection to rulers and to authorities, to be obedient, to be ready for every good work,
